purpose: Isolated S27 review proposal; not loaded by runtime, not replacing or approving v1. No medication regimen fields.

fields.definition: Whether a prior antipsychotic trial had clinically relevant inadequate response or intolerance.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-04.md — General Principles (lines276–280); Strategies to Address Initial Nonresponse or Partial Response (lines314–322)
fields.operationalization: Present requires a documented prior trial with inadequate response or intolerance, assessed at this encounter; Absent requires a documented assessment finding neither prior problem. No prior trial after explicit assessment maps Absent. Prior-response v1 alone cannot rule out intolerance; no pharmacy list inference.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: A treatment-related objection or practical barrier identified during shared discussion.
fields.operationalization: Present means clinician documents a stated patient objection or practical barrier to the established treatment, or to treatment discussion when none is established; Absent means discussion was completed and no such barrier identified. Missing discussion remains unknown, not Absent.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Assessed physical illness or age-related susceptibility relevant to treatment tolerability.
fields.operationalization: Present means clinician identifies a specific relevant physical condition or age-related vulnerability after assessment; Absent means relevant vulnerability was assessed and none identified. No age cutoff, automatic diagnosis or implication that physical illness is absent.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Assessed concomitant substance use potentially contributing to symptom response.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-04.md — Strategies to Address Initial Nonresponse or Partial Response (lines314–320)
fields.operationalization: Present means clinician identifies a potential current substance contribution; Absent means assessment found no identified contribution. Substance history not obtained is unknown. A positive category does not assign causation or establish nonresponse.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Assessed non-dose factors potentially changing exposure, such as smoking or relevant organ/metabolic factors.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-04.md — Drug-Drug Interactions and Metabolism (lines288–294); Pharmacokinetic Properties (lines296–298)
fields.operationalization: NoIdentifiedModifier requires assessment with no identified modifier; PossibleLowerExposure or PossibleHigherExposure requires a documented directional concern; MixedModifiers requires documented opposing concerns. No quantitative level, dose-relative category, regimen proxy or automated DDI severity conversion. When direction or applicability is unresolved pause. DDI findings remain a separate report.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Explicit established antipsychotic reference context, or explicitly assessed absence of established treatment.
fields.operationalization: A declared medication state requires clinician-confirmed established antipsychotic association and reconciliation with its candidate catalog ingredient ID. NoEstablishedTreatment requires an explicit assessment that no established antipsychotic treatment exists; an empty medication list or unknown history is insufficient. The source node name refers to historical oral-formulation Table6 categories, never a collected patient route or product recommendation. Multiple or unsupported established medication contexts pause; do not rank or choose a drug.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Elapsed established-treatment interval relative to a source-compatible initial-response review window, not trial adequacy.
fields.operationalization: Candidate initial-response reference: BeforeResponseWindow means elapsed interval less than 2 weeks; WithinResponseWindow means 2 through 4 weeks inclusive; BeyondResponseWindow means more than 4 weeks. Source describes2–4weeks for initial response and longer for full/optimal response. These are descriptive draft timing categories, never adequacy or nonresponse thresholds, and contain no dose requirement. Explicit no established treatment maps NoEstablishedTreatment. Unknown start/reference interval pauses.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: An independently assessed urgent safety concern requiring clinician attention.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-04.md — Treatment-Emergent Side Effects (lines332–338); Cardiovascular Effects (lines344–374); Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (lines436–442)
fields.operationalization: Present means clinician identifies an urgent safety concern during current assessment; Absent means an urgent-safety assessment was completed without identified concern. This is not a validated triage instrument, diagnosis or quantified threshold. Unknown assessment pauses; no-treatment does not imply absence. Routine generation must not delay urgent clinical assessment.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: A documented gap in relevant baseline or ongoing effectiveness/side-effect monitoring.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-04.md — Monitoring During Treatment (lines324–330); Quality Measurement Considerations (lines522–524)
fields.operationalization: Present means clinician identifies incomplete relevant monitoring after assessing what is appropriate to the treatment context; Absent requires a completed review finding no identified gap. With no established treatment, assess baseline/context discussion needs explicitly; never default Absent. Do not equate v1 baseline yes with complete ongoing monitoring or use unreviewed quality-measure thresholds.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

duration_reference_review.chosen_candidate: Source initial-response2–4week interval for descriptive timing only; not established treatment adequacy.
duration_reference_review.alternative_for_review: Individualized documented response window with concrete selection rules; unresolved owner-review option.
duration_reference_review.limitation: Full/optimal response can take longer; elapsed interval alone never authorizes a medication change or clozapine referral.

retained_history_v1: Twelve original v1 fields and runtime remain unchanged; this separately versioned adjunct proposes 9 additional CPT-context categories, none approved.
